verdict.rationale: Lever is a hosted SaaS applicant-tracking system, so choosing a data storage region is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions data residency, regional hosting or region selection. The pack covers APIs, webhooks, the sandbox, career sites, automation and AI features, none of which bear on where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
